comment: Etched-PCB layout for a 1590A: one colour component/wiring view plus the copper artwork; counted from the component view. The bypass footswitch and an indicator LED (no type given) are drawn on the board and left out; the 4.7K beside the LED is presumably its series resistor but is printed with a value. Three capacitors are drawn as lying boxes with polarity marks and are taken as electrolytics.
uncertain: 4.7K by the LED pad at the lower right: read clearly, counted with the other 4.7K (2 total); it is probably the LED resistor
